name: Leap
blurb: Determine whether a given year is a leap year.
instructions:
# Instructions

Your task is to determine whether a given year is a leap year.
introduction:
# Introduction

A leap year (in the Gregorian calendar) occurs:

- In every year that is evenly divisible by 4.
- Unless the year is evenly divisible by 100, in which case it's only a leap year if the year is also evenly divisible by 400.

Some examples:

- 1997 was not a leap year as it's not divisible by 4.
- 1900 was not a leap year as it's not divisible by 400.
- 2000 was a leap year!

~~~~exercism/note
For a delightful, four-minute explanation of the whole phenomenon of leap years, check out [this YouTube video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xX96xng7sAE).
~~~~

example_solution:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. LEAP.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-MODULUS-VALUES.
         02 WS-MOD400 PIC 999.
         02 WS-MOD100 PIC 999.
         02 WS-MOD004 PIC 999.
       01 WS-RESULT PIC 9.
       01 WS-YEAR PIC 9999.
       01 WS-TEMP PIC 9999.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       LEAP.
         DIVIDE WS-YEAR BY 400 GIVING WS-TEMP REMAINDER WS-MOD400.
         DIVIDE WS-YEAR BY 100 GIVING WS-TEMP REMAINDER WS-MOD100.
         DIVIDE WS-YEAR BY 4   GIVING WS-TEMP REMAINDER WS-MOD004.
         IF WS-MOD400 = 0 OR (WS-MOD100 <> 0 AND WS-MOD004 = 0)
            MOVE 1 TO WS-RESULT
         ELSE 
            MOVE 0 TO WS-RESULT
         END-IF.
       LEAP-EXIT.
         EXIT.
test_code:
TestCase "year not divisible by 4 in common year"
	MOVE 2015 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "year divisible by 2, not divisible by 4 in common year"
	MOVE 1970 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "year divisible by 4, not divisible by 100 in leap year"
	MOVE 1996 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "year divisible by 4 and 5 is still a leap year"
	MOVE 1960 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "year divisible by 100, not divisible by 400 in common year"
	MOVE 2100 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "year divisible by 100 but not by 3 is still not a leap year"
	MOVE 1900 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0

TestCase "year divisible by 400 is leap year"
	MOVE 2000 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "year divisible by 400 but not by 125 is still a leap year"
	MOVE 2400 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 1

TestCase "year divisible by 200, not divisible by 400 in common year"
	MOVE 1800 TO WS-YEAR
	PERFORM LEAP
	EXPECT WS-RESULT = 0
